abstain_handling: ABSTAIN in production comes from node_worthiness/link stages, never from validate(). This probe tests ONLY the assertion validator. Items flagged upstream-abstention-eligible under the frozen node_worthiness rule form a separate reporting stratum: in production they ABSTAIN upstream (worthiness/link), never inside validate(), so validate() output recorded for them says nothing about abstention behavior: validate() output is still recorded for them, but they are EXCLUDED from all primary denominators. ACCEPT/REJECT/ABSTAIN-eligible are therefore three separate reporting lines, never pooled.

arms.A_true_pairs: gold-YES relation, right direction, worthy mentions (from frozen T1/T2 positive twins and B7 gold-YES pairs pos17/pos38-analogs)
arms.B_false_pairs: pairs produced on gold-NO material (frozen T2/T2b negative pairs that yielded candidates)
arms.C_reversed_pairs: two-level gold: sentence_gold YES (the sentence asserts a provides relation) BUT pair_gold NO because the spans are direction-reversed relative to the asserted relation (B7 pos65 pattern: gold ad-hoc-groups -> parent committee vs pair parent-committee -> ad-hoc-groups)
arms.error_classes_B_vs_C: B and C are DIFFERENT error classes and must never be pooled: B = spurious pair (no provides relation in the sentence at all); C = misdirected pair (relation exists, spans flipped). They test different validator behaviors (existence judgment vs direction sensitivity).
arms.D_upstream_abstention_eligible: pairs with clearly unworthy/generic mentions per frozen node_worthiness rule (e.g. bare-plural team-members type); upstream-abstention-eligible reporting stratum only: in production these items ABSTAIN at the worthiness/link stages BEFORE any validator judgment, so this arm is explicitly NOT a test of validator abstention

candidate_input: FIXED pairs (sentence + subject/object spans) taken from frozen artifacts (T1/T2/T2b probes, B7 gold). nu_candidates is NEVER executed in this probe: candidate generation is frozen input, the validator is the unit under test. Strict separation by construction.
derived_from: docs/batch7_consolidation_v1.md section C (measurement question only; no design element invented beyond operationalizing it)
diagnostic_status: DESIGN ONLY - not executed, no validator run, no pipeline change
evaluation_units: pair level: one fixed (sentence, subject, object) triple per item; sentence-level aggregation reported additionally but never as the primary denominator
exclusion_leakage: no new sentences (all items reuse frozen probe/B7 sentences: zero new-text leakage surface); no T2/T2b verdict is altered by this probe; validator parse failures (no-brace responses) are reported as a separate technical-failure line, never counted as REJECT
gold_rules: assertion truth per frozen operational definition (does the sentence assert that X provides support/help/funding/encouragement to Y?); gold is REUSED from frozen probe/B7 gold artifacts (no new annotation, no re-labeling); assigned before any validator execution (already satisfied: gold predates this design)
measurement_question: where does selectivity arise: candidate generation or validator? This probe measures validator selectivity on fixed pairs; candidate-generation selectivity is already measured (T1/T2/T2b).

primary: rejection rate on arm B (validator selectivity on false pairs)
support rate on arm A (validator sensitivity on true pairs)
secondary: per-arm and per-frame-cell rates (descriptive, small n)
arm D behavior line (abstain-eligible reporting only)
arm C direction-error handling line (pair produced reversed: supported or not?)

no_hypothesis_prejudged: no direction of outcome is assumed; high selectivity and low selectivity are both recordable results with preregistered verdicts below
population: stratified fixed-pair set: A 8 true pairs, B 8 false pairs, C 4 reversed pairs, D 4 abstain-eligible pairs (24 items). Strata sizes fixed; no sampling, no replacement.
unit_under_test: validate() from scripts/trackb_two_stage.py (frozen) via the local router; router mode and per-request provider recorded from response metadata in the run artifact (provenance, following the B7 run lesson)

validity_and_verdicts_preregistered.invalid_probe: arm A support rate <6/8 (validator or setup misbehaving; no selectivity claim)
verdict_priority: 1. validity gate first: invalid_probe preempts ALL other verdicts regardless of arm B
selective/non_selective/mixed are mutually exclusive by construction (arm B rejection >=6 vs <=2 vs 3-5 is exhaustive and disjoint over 0-8); no tie-breaking choice can arise
validity_and_verdicts_preregistered.mixed_inconclusive: arm B rejection 3-5/8: report strata, no claim
